mapper.select: select semester_id as semesterId, semester_name as semesterName, start_date as startDate, end_date as endDate from brm_semester where status = '0' order by (start_date <= curdate() and end_date >= curdate()) desc, semester_id desc limit 1

select (select count(1) from sam_student where status = '0' and student_status = '0') as studentCount, (select count(1) from brm_teacher where status = '0') as teacherCount, (select count(1) from tpm_course_library where del_flag = '0') as courseCount, (select count(1) from brm_classroom where status = '0') as classroomCount, (select count(1) from tpm_course_offering where del_flag = '0' and offering_status != '2' and semester_id = #{semesterId}) as offeringCount, (select count(1) from tpm_schedule sc join tpm_course_offering off on off.offering_id = sc.offering_id where sc.del_flag = '0' and off.semester_id = #{semesterId}) as scheduleCount, (select count(1) from sam_warning where is_resolved = '0' and status = '0') as activeWarningCount, (select count(1) from sys_todo where status = '0') as pendingTodoCount, (select round(avg(pass_rate), 1) from aem_grade_statistics where status = '0' and semester_id = #{semesterId}) as avgPassRate, (select round(avg(excellent_rate), 1) from aem_grade_statistics where status = '0' and semester_id = #{semesterId}) as avgExcellentRate
select warning_level as level, count(1) as total from sam_warning where is_resolved = '0' and status = '0' group by warning_level order by warning_level

select ifnull(cl.course_name, concat('课程', s.course_id)) as courseName, s.pass_rate as passRate, s.avg_score as avgScore, s.fail_count as failCount from aem_grade_statistics s left join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = s.course_id where s.status = '0' and s.semester_id = #{semesterId} order by s.pass_rate asc, s.stat_id desc limit #{limit}

select e.result_status as resultStatus, count(1) as total from tpm_selection_enrollment e join tpm_selection_round r on r.round_id = e.round_id where e.del_flag = '0' and r.semester_id = #{semesterId} group by e.result_status order by e.result_status
